sections.section_title: MCE start address for region x register (MCE_SADDRx)
sections.text_helper: Section 51.6.8 "MCE start address for region x register (MCE_SADDRx)" in chapter 51 (Memory cipher engine (MCE)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2443.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x044 + 0x10 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 4)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Writes are ignored if GLOCK is set in MCE_CR register, or if BREN is set in MCE_REGCRx.
Bits 31:12 BADDSTART[31:12]: Region address start
This bitfield defines the absolute start address of the region x on 4Kbyte boundary
(inclusive).
BREN cannot be set if BADDRSTART > BADDREND.
When MCE determines the region, the first 12 bits (LSB) and the last 4 bits (MSB) in this
register are ignored, and when this register is accessed in read the 4 MSB bits and the 12
LSB bits return zeros (reference value in MCE).
Bits 11:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
